posts.title: Software as Art: Making Things in the Age of AI
posts.description: I recently gave a keynote at next.app devCon in Berlin . After the talk, I was asked whether the content was available anywhere, so I’ve adapted it into a short article here. AI tools are increasingly shaping the way we do design, engineering, testing, and everything in between.

posts.title: Using the Dump Menu Debug Feature on macOS 27 Beta
posts.description: The AppKit Debug menu is a debugging tool that has been shipping as part of the framework and hence macOS itself for a few years. The Dump Menu debug feature is a new addition in macOS 27 that I think could be useful.
